title: Checkout double-charges when the pay button is double-clicked

evidence.measurement: No in-flight guard: 2 requests observed in 1.2s in the staging replay, 1 charge each
disabled is set from a state update, so a second click lands before React re-renders

fix_sketch: Add a ref-based in-flight guard that flips synchronously on entry, before the first await, so a second click is dropped even if React has not re-rendered yet. The disabled attribute stays for the visual, but the ref is what actually prevents the duplicate request.
